✦ The Artist Behind the Nails

Meet Clare

"Every set of nails tells a story — I'm here to help you tell yours beautifully."

Hi, I'm Clare — a passionate nail technician with over 3 years of experience creating stunning, high-quality nail art. I believe every client deserves to feel like royalty, and I bring that energy to every single appointment.

From classic French tips to bold 3D designs, I specialise in making your vision a reality. I use only premium, skin-safe products because your health and happiness are my top priority.
